text: maya: Heads-up: onboarding sample app hit confusing auth error blobs. iOS returns {"error":"Unauthorized","detail":{"code":401,"msg":"token expired"}} while JS throws HTTPError(status=401, body='Unauthorized') — painful for sampleapp logic. sam: ouch, can you paste full examples? maya: pasted above. Also noticed 429s from Dedicated without Retry-After header. jordan: Agreed we need a consistent surface. Proposal: typed exceptions across SDKs: AuthError (401/403), RateLimitError (429 + retry_after_seconds), ServiceError (5xx). Include stable internal_code, human_message, docs_url. sam: non-breaking approach: add new fields on error objects and feature-flag for 2w before full flip. Backwards compat: keep message and http_status. jordan: add e2e tests in sampleapp to assert typed exceptions; i'll own that. liam: ops-bot: infra must include Retry-After header on 429. ops-bot: INF-512 created (P2) for Retry-After header rollout. maya: owners: sam (sdk + sample snippets), liam (server headers), jordan (tests + docs). sam: snippet for onboarding docs: try{await client.generate(...)}catch(err){if(err.code==='auth_error'||err instanceof AuthError){await refreshToken()}else if(err instanceof RateLimitError||err.retry_after_seconds){sleep(err.retry_after_seconds||backoff())}else{throw err}} maya: sampleapp logging guideline: only log human_message + correlation_id, avoid full stacks. devex-bot: created dashboard "error_shape_adoption" and watcher for legacy shapes. timeline: PRs by EOW, server header early next week, feature-flag 2w, canary monitor.
